insights.title: Class imbalance distorts accuracy
insights.body: 59.95% of labeled records are Low Risk, so majority-only prediction reaches the same accuracy.

insights.title: Balanced performance stays near chance
insights.body: The highest observed balanced accuracy is 34.15%, only 0.81% above the three-class reference.

insights.title: Shuffled labels perform almost identically
insights.body: Real-label and shuffled-target three-fold validation differ by less than two-tenths of a percentage point.

insights.title: Oversampling does not recover signal
insights.body: Corrected SMOTENC still returns approximately one-third balanced accuracy.

insights.title: Feature importance is weak and uncertain
insights.body: The largest permutation effect is only 0.0091 ± 0.0074 macro-F1.

insights.title: Customer clusters overlap
insights.body: Both original RFM variants have silhouette scores below 0.28, and the V2 numeric diagnostic is weaker.

insights.title: Anomaly screening still supports review
insights.body: 100 unusual profiles are ranked for human inspection without treating anomaly as fraud.
